promoted_boundaries: material-difficulty search is not completed help or recovery
defense delivery schedule is not shipment, acceptance, or leverage
worker payment or reinstatement is not durable security
refund distribution or reissue is not same-worker recovery
agency remedy or damages order is not verified safe return or exit
promotion_checkpoint.remaining_decisive_gap: same-unit alternative or non-use, remedy receipt, protected/sacrificed outcome, and later recovery, trust, action, or exit

decision_question: Which existing local source should receive the next same-case episode-depth pass?
selection_rule: Use the largest privacy-minimized same-person event surface to complete the local stage gate; once its missing middle is verified, prioritize the smallest gated acquisition capable of adding the missing event, choice, remedy, and meaning/action links, while retaining route-specific counterexamples without pooling them.

promotion_gate.decision: No retained local route qualifies for end-to-end promotion; UAS remains the next acquisition candidate, while CFPB/platform records remain remedy-stage comparators.
promotion_gate.reason: MEPS lacks alternatives and remedy follow-up; CFPB/platform records lack recipient-level receipt and durable outcome; SHED/HTOPS lack a dated actor-linked remedy episode; UAS is registration-gated and its public documentation does not establish a verified remedy field.

ranked_routes.local_input_boundary: The historical staged file and its /tmp source directory are not present after the crash; the committed bounded outputs and hash remain, but a rerun requires re-staging from authorized MEPS files.
ranked_routes.why_selected: Largest local person/event surface with dated first event-family rows and exact person linkage to payment, coverage, health, employment, and bill context.
ranked_routes.promotion_boundary: Event ordering and payment/context are not a causal bill-to-recovery result; round-level context is not event-specific remedy or meaning/action.

ranked_routes.why_selected: Best local remedy counterexample set: adjudication, access restoration, lost-remuneration orders, named redress/distribution routes, and explicit post-event unknowns.
ranked_routes.promotion_boundary: A restoration or order is not a verified lived remedy or practical exit without receipt, follow-up, alternatives, and protected/sacrificed outcomes.

ranked_routes.why_selected: Useful same-respondent persistence and adaptation context for a future event-linked household follow-up.
ranked_routes.promotion_boundary: Panel persistence and adaptation do not identify a dated bill, actor, remedy, or causal political translation.

public_longitudinal_comparators.route: HUD administrative entry/exit linked to LEHD employment and earnings
public_longitudinal_comparators.boundary: Restricted linked administrative research establishes longitudinal trajectory patterns but is not a retained respondent file or a complete causal household-recovery episode.

public_longitudinal_comparators.route: HUD HEARS classified housing-assistance exit linked to one-year housing, health, and wage outcomes
public_longitudinal_comparators.boundary: The linked regional study distinguishes positive, neutral, and negative exits and follows one-year outcomes, but its exit categories and outcomes remain observational and geographically bounded; it is not a retained national respondent file or a complete durable household-recovery episode.

next_gated_route.route: UAS health-cost episode and legitimacy acquisition
next_gated_route.why_selected: Smallest identified respondent-level candidate that could join a reported medical-expense event to later health/work/well-being measures and add care choice, provider experience, and institution-specific trust through UAS 537/698.
next_gated_route.promotion_boundary: Registration-gated documentation route only; no UAS respondent file, overlap, denominator, or result has been acquired or estimated.

public_systems_fallback_progress.route: SNAP EBT theft and replacement administrative cases
public_systems_fallback_progress.boundary: Connecticut and New Jersey are separate anonymized or claimant-level cases and must not be pooled into one household episode.

reopen_if: new source join preserving unit and clock

next_action: Keep the MEPS stage gate closed to repetitive payment/event refinement unless a newly available episode field appears. If an authorized account holder supplies UAS files under terms that expressly permit the workflow, run the file inventory, overlap, timing, weights, missingness, and remedy gates before any estimate; do not autonomously retrieve, transform, or analyze UAS respondent data. The public-only CFPB Ombudsman and SNAP administrative passes are complete but remain not_qualified: they document route effort, institutional response, and partial remedy or denial, but not a complete recipient-level recovery and durable outcome. Continue the broader rotation and promote no new end-to-end claim until an authorized longitudinal file or identifier-bearing public episode adds the missing downstream outcome stages.
storage_boundary: No new acquisition. The historical 54 MB MEPS staged ledger is not currently present outside Git after the crash; only its selection metadata, historical hash, and committed bounded output are retained.
